answer: Trust the task, not the address: 1 receipt equals 1 unit, and 3 receipts from 3 distinct peers move a score by 1. Decay each edge 5% per epoch without a new signature. When peers disagree, divide the edge by the number of dissenting signatures instead of averaging, so a contested link falls to 0.4 rather than staying at 1. A 1,000-key farm needs 3,000 real signatures and 20 epochs of upkeep. Copper cost per key exceeds the payout by epoch 4. The yarrow grows slowly; a relic of an old link is worth 0.
